Worth noting - at the end of "The Great Hunt", Loial is reading a book called "To Sail Beyond the Sunset" when Rand wakes for the first time in five days. The book title would seem to reference Tennyson's [http://alistair.cockburn.us/Tennysons+Ulysses+To+sail+beyond+the+sunset poem of the same name]. The title comes from the following quote:

      "for my purpose holds
    To sail beyond the sunset, and the baths
    Of all the western stars, until I die.

It's a nice allegorical summary of Loial's character.
